name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd.
about: Vishal Mega Mart Limited engages in the wholesale, trading, and retail of apparel, fast moving consumer goods, and general merchandise in India. The company offers apparel, including t-shirts, classics, fashion, lingerie, men's formal and casual, kids' wear, women's casual and ethnic, denims, athleisure, infant wear, and girl's wear products; and general merchandise, such as home appliances and furnishings, crockery, utensils, and travel products, as well as footwear and lifestyle products. It also provides fast-moving consumer goods comprising staples, packaged food, women hygiene, home care, personal care, infant diapers, savoury products, dairy and confectionery, kitchen roll napkin, facial tissue, and incense products.
